name: featured-products
description: Headline + hand-picked products shown as product tiles (live product data). Usable on any page.

products.description: Pick product stories of this brand. Their current name, image and price are shown.

picker_contract.plugin: ext-picker-content (org field plugin; stored value shape UNKNOWN)
picker_contract.startsWith_note: Field options are per component schema, NOT per brand. The shared schema can't hold 'fischer/produkte' AND 'fischertechnik/produkte'. Default = empty (all stories; renderer keeps only component 'product'). If the plugin supports a path placeholder (e.g. '{0}/produkte' = first segment of the current story), set that instead. Open question #1.
picker_contract.normalize: normalizeProductRefs(value): value may be an array, or an object with items|stories|value|selected array. Each entry may be a string (uuid = 36-char UUID; numeric = id; else full_slug/slug) or an object carrying uuid | id | full_slug | slug (also nested under .story or .content). Output: ordered, de-duplicated list of {uuid?|id?|full_slug?}. Unknown shapes -> [] + console.warn with the raw value (dev only).
picker_contract.fetch: uuids -> cdn/stories?by_uuids_ordered=...; full_slugs -> cdn/stories?by_slugs=...; ids -> cdn/stories/{id} (parallel). Always pass language = current locale and the same version as the page (draft in preview). Keep only story.content.component === 'product'; keep editor order.
picker_contract.render: ProductTile per product (shared renderer component, NOT an editor block); variant per brand theme preset.

fallback.note: Native Storyblok multi-story reference (stores uuids, editor order). '{0}' = first path segment of the edited story = brand folder, so the native fallback IS brand-scoped. Same normalize/fetch path (uuids).

spacing_top.description: Background-matched vertical space top the section (replaces the source's divider spacers): md = 96px, lg = 120px.

spacing_bottom.description: Background-matched vertical space bottom the section (replaces the source's divider spacers): md = 96px, lg = 120px.

view.name: FeaturedProducts
view.notes: Server component: normalizeProductRefs(products) -> fetch stories (see picker_contract) -> <ProductRail>. Layout from ft#8: band bg, content in the narrow 1146 column (x147): header row = h2 21/31 600 left + arrow pair right (44x44 white squares, disabled = muted arrow); 72px gap; track of ProductTiles 268.5x386 at 293 pitch, 4 visible. <= 4 products -> static row, no arrows. Optional CTA (button) centered below, mt 48. Band padding 72 top / 96 bottom (source) inside spacing tokens.

interaction.evidence: fischertechnik-pdp#8: Splide product-teasers carousel, 13 slides, 4 visible, arrow controls top-right, no dots, no autoplay. items_field is a picker (custom) field resolved to product stories, not bloks.
